AnalyzeRequest.description:
Exactly one product reference: our own ``product_id``, or a ``barcode`` (OFF products
have no product_id). With no ``member_ids`` the account's primary member is used.
AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest

ColumnConfirm.description: What to ask when the user saves with this `basis` (`ProductCreate.basis`).

confirm_fields.description: Fields that need an explicit tick (`ProductCreate.confirmed_fields`) when this basis is saved; an unticked one is stored as null. `serving_size_g`, when listed and unticked on a per-serving or derived save, makes every nutrient null. Sodium is never listed when `sodium_unit_required` (the unit pick confirms it).
confirm_fields.title: Confirm Fields

printed.description: The draft column of this name holds printed engine values (`per_100g` of a `derived_from_serving` draft never does: those numbers were calculated).
printed.title: Printed

shared.description: On a `basis_mismatch` draft, this is the only printed column: show its values whichever basis the user picks (its basis is the doubt).
shared.title: Shared

sodium_unit_required.description: Show a mg/g picker for sodium: `ProductCreate.sodium_unit` must be `mg` or `g` (never null) whenever the saved sodium is not null, else 422 `body.sodium_unit`.
sodium_unit_required.title: Sodium Unit Required

ConfirmColumns.description: The bases the user may save with; null = not offered for this draft.
ConfirmColumns.title: ConfirmColumns

DraftConfirm.description:
Server-computed confirm-screen hints (R21). Clients render these; they never
re-derive the save rules. Computed from the draft itself, so always current.

basis_required.description: Basis in doubt: offer both columns and never preselect a basis.
basis_required.title: Basis Required

category_required.description: Category in doubt: never preselect; the user must pick a category.
category_required.title: Category Required

DraftConfirm.title: DraftConfirm

DraftNutrients.description:
Per 100 g / 100 ml for the confirm screen. None = not printed (never invented).

The engine fields are M1's `NutrientsOut`. `added_sugars_g` and `trans_fat_g` are
shown for the user to confirm but are NOT engine inputs (the engine's `Nutrients`
has no such fields), so `ProductCreate.per_100g` (a `NutrientsOut`) drops them on save.
DraftNutrients.title: DraftNutrients

ErrorEnvelope.description: The only error shape the API returns (never FastAPI's `{"detail": [...]}`).
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

HealthOut.description:
`ok`/`ok` (200); `degraded`/`error` when the database is unreachable (503);
`unavailable`/`schema_behind` when its Alembic revision is not this build's head (503).
HealthOut.title: HealthOut

PrintedNutrients.description:
One nutrition-table column exactly as the pack prints it (see `ProductCreate.basis`).

Numbers only, no arithmetic: the server converts the basis and the sodium unit. A value
not printed (or blanked by the user) is null, never 0. The nine engine fields are
required (send null when not printed); `added_sugars_g` and `trans_fat_g` are optional
and shown only, never engine inputs.

sodium_mg.description: Sodium as the number printed, in the unit given by `ProductCreate.sodium_unit` (mg when that is null; the server converts g to mg).
sodium_mg.title: Sodium Mg

PrintedNutrients.title: PrintedNutrients

ProductCreate.description:
A product the user confirmed on the label-confirm screen, or typed by hand.

**The server does all nutrient arithmetic; the client only transcribes what the pack
prints and records the user's explicit choices.** The stored per-100 g values are:

1. `nutrients` as sent, with `sodium_mg` multiplied by 1000 when `sodium_unit` is `g`;
2. then, when `basis` is `per_serving`, every value x 100 / `serving_size_g`;
3. then, for a scan save, values the draft holds back are set to null unless confirmed
   (`confirmed_fields`, below);
4. then the engine's plausibility check runs on exactly the values that will be stored
   (422 `implausible_value`), including `serving_size_g` only when it will be stored or
   used for conversion. Values are never rounded.

With `scan_id` the values come from that label scan (source `label`, the extraction
confidence, which user edits never raise); without it the entry is manual (source
`user`, confidence 1.0, values taken as typed). For a scan save the server re-runs its
current normaliser on the stored raw extraction (R19), so the warnings it applies can be
stricter than the draft the client showed; scans without a stored raw extraction use the
stored draft. Text keeps its script (Devanagari stays Devanagari); only surrounding
whitespace is trimmed and blank items are dropped.

**Clients do not re-derive the rules below: render `ProductDraft.confirm` (R21), which
the server computes with the same helpers that enforce them.** A body that honours the
hints is stored in full; one that ignores them is a 422 or stores null for each field it
did not confirm.

Every request counts toward the account's daily `product_creates` limit (429
`rate_limited`), including requests rejected with 422, so a client should fix the body
before retrying rather than resend it.

Scan-save rules (422 `validation_error` with `details.fields` naming the field):
- `category` and `basis` are always required (the user must pick them; nothing defaults).
- (R19) `sodium_unit` must be `mg` or `g` (not null) whenever the draft has ANY
  `unit_unconfirmed:*.sodium_mg` warning (either column, whichever `basis` is chosen) and
  `nutrients.sodium_mg` is not null; else 422 `["body.sodium_unit"]`. Listing `sodium_mg`
  in `confirmed_fields` never stands in for the unit. A non-null unit confirms sodium.
- (R19) With `basis` `per_serving`, or whenever the draft was `derived_from_serving`
  (with or without `basis_mismatch`), every nutrient is stored only if `confirmed_fields`
  contains `serving_size_g` (the user checked the serving size); otherwise all are
  stored null and the serving size is neither used nor checked.
- (R18) The stored `serving_size_g` is the sent value only if `confirmed_fields` contains
  `serving_size_g`; otherwise it is stored null (unknown) and the engine falls back to
  per-100 g. A manual entry (no `scan_id`) stores the serving size as typed.
- On a `basis_mismatch` draft the explicit `basis` confirms the values sent. (R19) An
  upper-bound ("<X") protein or fibre on EITHER printed column is stored only if listed
  in `confirmed_fields`, and a unit-less sodium still needs `sodium_unit`.

basis.description: Required: which printed column `nutrients` was transcribed from. `per_100g` means per 100 g or 100 ml; `per_serving` means per `serving_size_g`, and the server converts to per 100 g.
basis.title: Basis

category.description: Required: the user's explicit choice (drinks are judged on drink limits).
category.title: Category

confirmed_fields.description: Scan saves only: what the user explicitly confirmed. A nutrient the draft lists in `engine_withheld`, or an upper-bound ("<0.1 g") protein or fibre on either printed column (R19), is stored only when listed here, else null. `serving_size_g` confirms the serving size and is required for any value of a per-serving save or a `derived_from_serving` draft to be stored (R19); an unconfirmed scanned serving size is stored as null (R18). Listing `sodium_mg` never replaces `sodium_unit`.
confirmed_fields.title: Confirmed Fields

nutrients.description: The chosen column as printed. The server converts it (see `basis`).

scan_id.description: The label scan this came from; null for manual entry.
scan_id.title: Scan Id

serving_size_g.description: Serving size in g (or ml). Required when `basis` is `per_serving`. For a scan save it is used for conversion and stored only when `confirmed_fields` lists it (R18); otherwise it is stored as null, and is not plausibility-checked because it is neither stored nor used (R19). A manual entry stores it as typed.
serving_size_g.title: Serving Size G

sodium_unit.description: The unit of `nutrients.sodium_mg`: null means mg (the unit is printed, or this is a manual entry in mg). `g` is converted to mg by the server. Send the user's explicit pick (`mg` or `g`, never null) whenever the scan draft has any `unit_unconfirmed:*.sodium_mg` warning (either column, whatever the basis) and sodium is not null, else 422 `body.sodium_unit` (R19). A non-null unit confirms sodium; `confirmed_fields` never replaces it.
sodium_unit.title: Sodium Unit

profile_set_up.description: False: age/allergies/diet may not be set; clients show a 'profile not set up' note. Display metadata only; never changes status or reasons.
profile_set_up.title: Profile Set Up

post.description:
Save a confirmed label draft (``scan_id``) or a manual entry as a pending product.

Then call ``analyze_create`` with the returned ``product_id``.

409.description: A product with this barcode exists

post.description:
Extract an unconfirmed draft from an uploaded label photo.

Rate-limited per account (`rate_limited_scans`), counting only paid extractions: the
same image bytes again (from any account) reuse the stored extraction for free (it is
normalised afresh), and the same `path` posted again returns the same `scan_id`.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image

post.description:
A signed URL to PUT one label photo into the caller's private folder.

Creates the caller's account row on first use (the photo is account-owned).
